info.name: A7 Analytics Platform - Algo management Algo management API Order book API API

params.name: marketId
params.description: Market identifier code as specified in ISO 10383.

params.name: date
params.description: Trading day in the format  YYYYMMDD

params.name: marketSegmentId
params.description: Unique product identifier or product pool identifier on T7.

params.name: securityId
params.description: Unique security identifier

params.name: from
params.description:
Timestamp of when the order book was valid or starting time of the time interval.
Format: Nanoseconds since 1970 (EOBI TransactTime)

params.name: to
params.description:
Ending time of the time interval.
Format: Nanoseconds since 1970 (EOBI TransactTime)

params.name: limit
params.description: Max number of elements in the response (Minimum = 1 / Maximum = 10000).

params.name: levels
params.description: Define depth of the order book.

params.name: orderbook
params.description:
Define if orders should be shown or aggregated.</br> Mode options:
  * aggregated = Aggregate orders
  * complete = Display orders

params.name: trades
params.description: Display trades.

params.name: indicatives
params.description: Indicative auction uncrossing.

items.docs: The request delivers either the order book valid at a given time or a list of order books for a given time period.</br> If `limit` is equal to `1`, the response will contain a single order book otherwise the response will contain a list of order books.</br> If `from` query parameter is not provided, the first order book of the day will be returned.
